scope: Run hosted Core shard 4 with one contract file at a time, keep two for every other shard, sample free -m and the largest processes every 30 s during each shard step, stop the sampler without changing the shard status, and refresh exactly the one matching workflow source pin. The Core profile, shard partition, support cells and evidence scope are unchanged. Register the complete transition newest-first; hosted Core remains the terminal acceptance gate.

edits.current:
# Sample memory every 30 s so a lost runner still names its largest processes.
          (
            while sleep 30; do
              echo "core-memory $(date -u +%H:%M:%SZ)"
              free -m
              ps -eo pid,rss,etime,args --sort=-rss | head -n 6 | cut -c1-200
            done
          ) &
          memory_sampler=$!
          trap 'kill "$memory_sampler" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

// Shard 4 lost its hosted runner twice with two concurrent files; run it serially.
const hostedCoreConcurrency = shard === "4/12" ? "--test-concurrency=1" : "--test-concurrency=2";

assert.match(contractJob, /run: \|
 {10}source scripts/env\.sh
 {10}# Sample memory every 30 s so a lost runner still names its largest processes\.
 {10}\(
 {12}while sleep 30; do
 {14}echo "core-memory \$\(date -u \+%H:%M:%SZ\)"
 {14}free -m
 {14}ps -eo pid,rss,etime,args --sort=-rss \| head -n 6 \| cut -c1-200
 {12}done
 {10}\) &
 {10}memory_sampler=\$!
 {10}trap 'kill "\$memory_sampler" 2>/dev/null \|\| true' EXIT
 {10}bash scripts/run-test-profile\.sh contract \
/u
		, "Every shard must sample memory in the background and stop the sampler without changing the shard status");
	assert.equal([...source.matchAll(/^\s+trap /gmu)].length, 1
		, "Only the shard step may install an exit trap");

, source.replace("while sleep 30; do", "while sleep 300; do")
		, source.replace("              free -m\n", "")
		, source.replace("--sort=-rss | head -n 6", "--sort=pid | head -n 6")
		, source.replace("          trap 'kill \"$memory_sampler\" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT\n", "")
		, source.replace("2>/dev/null || true' EXIT", "2>/dev/null; exit 0' EXIT")
		, source.replace("          ) &\n", "          )\n")
